## [0.35.0] - 2026-09-21

A Demo API tile for a first run with an empty workspace, plus fixes to the
Import dialog's tab strip, a Monaco editing bug in variable popovers, and the
scripting docs for `pm.request.body`.

### Added

- The Launcher now shows a **Demo API** tile below its action grid while your
  workspace has no runs yet. It sends a real request against a public demo
  endpoint, so there's something to see execute before you write your own -
  it goes away once you've run anything.

### Fixed

- Editing a variable in a token's popover and pressing Enter to commit could
  split the line underneath it in the editor instead, because focus returned
  to the editor before Enter's own newline action landed.
- The Import dialog's File/URL/Paste tabs rendered at the smaller size meant
  for a tab strip nested inside a section, not a dialog's own top-level
  navigation.
- The scripting docs and completions for `pm.request.body` didn't say that
  assigning it directly (`pm.request.body = ...`) replaces the whole object -
  a later `pm.request.body.raw` read in the same script then returned
  `undefined` instead of the string just set.
